logistics_recon.id AS id, logistics_recon.create_time AS createTime, logistics_recon.update_time AS updateTime, logistics_recon.version AS version, logistics_recon.is_deleted AS isDeleted, logistics_recon.create_user_id AS createUserId, logistics_recon.create_user_name AS createUserName, logistics_recon.update_user_id AS updateUserId, logistics_recon.update_user_name AS updateUserName, logistics_recon.code AS code, logistics_recon.reconciliation_month AS reconciliationMonth, logistics_recon.business_type AS businessType, logistics_recon.cfg_import_id AS cfgImportId, logistics_recon.cfg_type AS cfgType, logistics_recon.supplier_id AS supplierId, logistics_recon.supplier_name AS supplierName, logistics_recon.sheet_name AS sheetName, logistics_recon.file_url AS fileUrl, logistics_recon.file_name AS fileName, logistics_recon.import_fail_reason AS importFailReason, logistics_recon.check_status AS checkStatus, logistics_recon.import_count AS importCount, logistics_recon.cost_count AS costCount, logistics_recon.cost_count AS validCostCount, logistics_recon.total_amount AS totalAmount, logistics_recon.match_count AS matchCount, logistics_recon.match_success_amount AS matchSuccessAmount, logistics_recon.match_fail_amount AS matchFailAmount, logistics_recon.reconciliation_status AS reconciliationStatus, logistics_recon.currency AS currency, logistics_recon.check_user_id AS checkUserId, logistics_recon.check_user_name AS checkUserName, logistics_recon.check_time AS checkTime, logistics_recon.remark AS remark
mapper.update: WITH stats AS ( SELECT m.id, m.version AS expected_version, COUNT(v.id)::int AS valid_cost_count, (COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.match_status = 'matched'))::int AS match_count, COALESCE(SUM(v.local_amount) FILTER (WHERE v.match_status = 'matched'), 0) AS match_success_amount, COALESCE(SUM(v.local_amount) FILTER (WHERE v.match_status = 'failed'), 0) AS match_fail_amount, COUNT(v.id)::int AS reconciliation_total_count, (COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.reconciliation_status = 'confirmed'))::int AS reconciliation_confirmed_count, (COUNT(v.id) FILTER (WHERE v.reconciliation_status = 'partialConfirm'))::int AS reconciliation_partial_count FROM logistics_recon m LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sub.id, sub.main_id, sub.match_status, sub.local_amount, sub.reconciliation_status FROM logistics_recon_detail_sub sub INNER JOIN logistics_recon_detail d ON d.id = sub.detail_id AND d.is_deleted = false AND d.main_id = sub.main_id WHERE sub.is_deleted = false AND sub.main_id = #{mainId} ) v ON v.main_id = m.id WHERE m.id = #{mainId} AND m.is_deleted = false GROUP BY m.id ) UPDATE logistics_recon m SET cost_count = stats.valid_cost_count, match_count = stats.match_count, match_success_amount = stats.match_success_amount, match_fail_amount = stats.match_fail_amount, reconciliation_status = CASE WHEN stats.reconciliation_total_count <= 0 OR (stats.reconciliation_confirmed_count <= 0 AND stats.reconciliation_partial_count <= 0) THEN 'toBeConfirm' WHEN stats.reconciliation_confirmed_count >= stats.reconciliation_total_count THEN 'confirmed' ELSE 'partialConfirm' END, update_user_id = #{updateUserId}, update_user_name = #{updateUserName}, version = COALESCE(version, 0) + 1, update_time = NOW() FROM stats WHERE m.id = stats.id AND m.version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM stats.expected_version AND m.is_deleted = false

WITH current_main AS ( SELECT id, version AS expected_version FROM logistics_recon WHERE id = #{mainId} AND is_deleted = false ) UPDATE logistics_recon m SET match_count = COALESCE(match_count, 0) + #{matchCountDelta}, match_success_amount = COALESCE(match_success_amount, 0) + #{matchSuccessAmountDelta}, -- 失败金额是当前 FAILED 状态的汇总，不是失败尝试次数的累计值。 -- 重试场景下同一费用项可能多次进入 FAILED，必须按明细当前状态重算。 match_fail_amount = COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(sub.local_amount) FROM logistics_recon_detail_sub sub INNER JOIN logistics_recon_detail d ON d.id = sub.detail_id AND d.is_deleted = false AND d.main_id = sub.main_id WHERE sub.main_id = logistics_recon.id AND sub.is_deleted = false AND sub.match_status = 'failed' ), 0), update_user_id = #{updateUserId}, update_user_name = #{updateUserName}, version = COALESCE(version, 0) + 1, update_time = NOW() FROM current_main WHERE m.id = current_main.id AND m.version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM current_main.expected_version AND m.is_deleted = false
